problem_statement: The NCP Spinel codec layer cannot encode or decode DNS-SD TXT resolution result messages or IPv6/IPv4 address resolution result and resolver messages. When the host sends a SPINEL_CMD_PROP_VALUE_SET frame for these message types, the NCP has no way to parse the payload or invoke the corresponding callback. A client application that starts a TXT resolver or an IPv6 address resolver and expects to receive results via the platform callback mechanism will find that no handler exists for these property keys, and the codec layer cannot serialize the results back to the NCP. The system needs to support encoding and decoding for these four new Spinel property types (TXT resolver, TXT result, IPv6 address resolver, IPv6 address result) in the Spinel property codec so that DNS-SD TXT resolution and address resolution can be bridged between the host and the NCP over Spinel.
